mapper.update: UPDATE `users` SET USER_STATUS = 'LOCKED', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND USER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE `users` SET LAST_LOGIN_AT = CASE WHEN USER_STATUS = 'DORMANT' THEN NOW() ELSE LAST_LOGIN_AT END, USER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND USER_STATUS IN ('LOCKED', 'BANNED', 'DORMANT')
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, LOGIN_ID AS loginId, PASSWORD AS password, USER_ROLE AS userRole, USER_STATUS AS userStatus FROM users WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, LOGIN_ID AS loginId, USER_STATUS AS userStatus, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM users WHERE USER_STATUS IN ('LOCKED', 'BANNED', 'DORMANT') ORDER BY USER_ID DESC
